component.name: SerproID
component.summary: Serpro cloud certificate driver for Tessera
Driver do certificado em nuvem do Serpro para o Tessera

description.p: SerproID makes Serpro's cloud certificate available as a token. Tessera loads it like any other driver, so browsers, PDF readers and document signers that use Tessera's tokens can sign with it; each signature is approved in the SerproID phone app.
It also adds the SerproID app to Tessera's window, to sign in and download the certificate.

This extension installs Serpro's official Linux package, downloaded at install time and checked against a pinned checksum. Only its files are taken: no install script runs, and the app's launcher is pointed at its copy inside the extension. SerproID is closed source and not made or endorsed by Tessera's author.
The driver runs inside Tessera's sandbox with Tessera's permissions and has none of its own. After installing it, use Restart Tessera in Tessera's menu.
